caption.zh: CPU 管计算，Arc 140V 集显管画面。
caption.en: CPU for computation; Arc 140V for graphics.

concept.en: 258V: office work, coding, and light editing

explanation.zh: 灵耀 14 Air / Zenbook S14 搭载 Core Ultra 7 258V，集成显卡为 Arc 140V。CPU 负责程序计算，集显主要负责游戏画面。
explanation.en: The Zenbook S14 uses a Core Ultra 7 258V with Arc 140V graphics. The CPU runs calculations; the integrated GPU handles most game rendering.

ability.zh: 论文、会议、编程学习、修图和轻量剪辑。部分游戏可用集显运行，具体画质和帧率见下方。
ability.en: Papers, calls, programming courses, photo editing, and light video work. See the gaming section for supported settings and FPS.

boundary.zh: 8 核 8 线程，大型全量编译和长时间 CPU 渲染耗时较长。32 GB 封装内存无法升级。
boundary.en: Its 8 cores and 8 threads take longer on large full builds and sustained CPU renders. The 32 GB of on-package memory cannot be upgraded.

tag.zh: 多核任务 / 集显游戏

caption.zh: 12 核 CPU 与 Radeon 890M 分别看。
caption.en: Assess the 12-core CPU and Radeon 890M separately.

concept.zh: HX 370：多任务、编译与集显游戏
concept.en: HX 370: multitasking, builds, and integrated gaming

explanation.zh: Zenbook S16 搭载 Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 和 Radeon 890M。12 核 CPU 用于编译和 CPU 渲染，890M 负责图形任务。
explanation.en: The Zenbook S16 pairs a Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 with Radeon 890M. Its 12-core CPU handles builds and CPU rendering; the 890M handles graphics.

ability.zh: 多程序并开、并行编译、修图和视频剪辑。890M 可运行轻量游戏，部分大型游戏需要降低画质。
ability.en: Multiple apps, parallel builds, photo work, and video editing. The 890M supports lighter games and some demanding titles at lower settings.

boundary.zh: 游戏帧率受画质和内存带宽影响；长时间编译、导出还受薄机身散热限制。
boundary.en: Game FPS depends on quality settings and memory bandwidth. Cooling in the thin chassis also limits sustained builds and exports.

caption.zh: 本例为 10 核 CPU / 8 核 GPU 配置。
caption.en: This example uses the 10-core CPU / 8-core GPU option.

concept.en: M4: macOS development and everyday editing

explanation.zh: 这台 MacBook Air 使用 M4，配置为 10 核 CPU、8 核 GPU。剪辑受支持的视频格式时，可调用媒体引擎加速。
explanation.en: This MacBook Air has an M4 with a 10-core CPU and 8-core GPU. Its media engine accelerates supported video formats.

ability.zh: macOS 办公、网页开发、修图和日常视频剪辑。已适配的软件可使用芯片的计算与媒体加速。
ability.en: Office work, web development, photo editing, and everyday video projects on macOS. Compatible apps can use the chip’s compute and media acceleration.

boundary.zh: 先确认所需软件、插件和游戏支持 macOS。长时间编译、渲染和导出需查看 Air 的持续性能测试。
boundary.en: Check macOS support for your software, plug-ins, and games. For long builds, renders, and exports, consult sustained-performance tests of the Air.
